slices.title: Add OHDER semantic fact envelope runtime
slices.description: Create a shared semantic fact model with confidence, evidence, source traces, recommendations, and backward-compatible flat OHDER facts.
acceptanceCriteria: Architect status includes semanticFacts.
Existing ohderFacts remains backward compatible.
Each semantic fact includes metric, value, confidence, source, evidence, and recommendations.

slices.title: Add OHDER SSoT semantic analyzer
slices.description: Detect duplicate governed-state authorities and map them to SSoT integrity facts and hard-law behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate governed-state authority produces ssot_integrity invalid.
Approved authority paths remain valid.
Strict mode blocks SSoT hard-law violations.

slices.title: Add OHDER event-only sync analyzer
slices.description: Detect direct synchronization or state overwrite paths that bypass event-ledger or projection authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct non-event sync mutation produces event_only_sync invalid.
Approved event/projection authorities remain valid.
Strict mode blocks invalid event-only sync.

slices.title: Add OHDER duplication and DRY analyzer
slices.description: Detect meaningful duplication in changed files and feed duplication risk into architecture score and entropy history.
acceptanceCriteria: Meaningful duplication is reported with file evidence.
Boilerplate does not create noisy findings.
Duplication affects score and entropy trend.

slices.title: Add OHDER observability analyzer
slices.description: Detect runtime changes that weaken replayability or debugging evidence by adding behavior without events, status fields, or diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Governance/runtime behavior without diagnostics is reported.
Event-backed and diagnostic-rich changes stay low risk.
Observability trend appears in entropy history.

slices.title: Add OHDER testability analyzer
slices.description: Detect untested runtime behavior and hard-to-validate code shapes such as filesystem-coupled decisions and CLI-heavy logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Untested behavior changes are visible in architect status.
Matching tests reduce risk.
Score impact is deterministic.

slices.title: Add OHDER replaceability and YAGNI analyzer
slices.description: Detect infrastructure leakage and speculative abstractions that make the system harder to evolve.
acceptanceCriteria: Infrastructure leakage is reported.
Speculative abstractions are warning-only.
Replaceability score changes deterministically.

slices.title: Upgrade OHDER security boundary semantics
slices.description: Move security analysis from basic path/content signals toward explicit auth, permission, token, secret, and route-boundary semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Security findings include auth/authz/token/secret categories.
Matching security tests lower risk.
Strict mode blocks high-confidence security boundary violations.

slices.title: Deepen OHDER mode profiles
slices.description: Make fast, strict, and refactor materially different governance profiles with policy-driven validation requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Modes have observable behavioral differences.
Refactor mode prevents normal feature slices unless policy-exempted.
Strict mode deepens validation requirements.

slices.title: Add mutating governance validation runtime
slices.description: Add ask governance validate to refresh governance evidence, write a decision, and affect ask next recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Governance validation is an explicit mutating runtime action.
It writes evidence and decision state.
ask next responds to refreshed validation evidence.

slices.title: Add ranked refactor target portfolio
slices.description: Move refactor targeting from one candidate to a ranked portfolio with reasons, blast radius, confidence, and freshness.
acceptanceCriteria: OHDER exposes multiple ranked refactor candidates.
The selected candidate remains deterministic.
Completed targets are not repeatedly suggested.

slices.title: Add autonomous entropy reduction controller
slices.description: Let ASK create bounded remediation tasks from high-confidence OHDER recommendations under policy without applying code patches automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: OHDER can autonomously create bounded refactor tasks when policy allows.
It cannot mutate code directly.
It respects confidence, blast radius, worktree, and per-session limits.

slices.title: Add OHDER patch readiness gate
slices.description: Define the gate for future high-confidence autonomous patch application without enabling patch application yet.
acceptanceCriteria: ASK can say whether a patch would be safe to consider.
ASK still does not apply patches automatically.
Future autonomy boundary remains explicit.

slices.title: Add council-lite architecture review envelope
slices.description: Add a deterministic multi-perspective architecture review envelope before full architectural councils exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Architect status has deterministic multi-perspective review evidence.
Full architectural councils remain marked future.
Review output is replayable.

slices.title: Document OHDER semantic autonomy runtime
slices.description: Update README, operations docs, and release notes to explain semantic facts, deeper analyzers, governance validate, and bounded autonomy.
acceptanceCriteria: Docs distinguish implemented semantic autonomy from future patch autonomy.
Operators can see how to run governance validation and interpret semantic facts.
Release note explains why this is a significant OHDER maturity release.
